gradient_utility_audit.claim_boundary: In this frozen Llama-3.2-1B/GSM8K no-update setting, M4 adds substantial held-out predictive information about exact group-gradient magnitude beyond token count, reward mean, reward variance, and truncation, but it does not add held-out information about consensus-gradient direction or outperform reward variance on the preregistered directional rank comparison.

gradient_utility_robustness.claim_boundary: These post-primary checks assess robustness of the frozen magnitude interpretation. They do not alter the MAGNITUDE_ONLY classification or establish directional utility, scheduler efficacy, terminal-quality improvement, production readiness, or cross-setting generalization.

summary.interpretation: M4 is a strong complementary predictor of exact gradient magnitude conditional on the baseline covariates, but it is not a useful standalone magnitude predictor in this acquisition.

limitations.shared_reference: Both reference interactions reuse the same two GSM8K cells.

robustness_notes.common_window: Registered full and common windows are both versions 8--407; versions 408--447 are the frozen guard window.
robustness_notes.missingness: Sharp endpoints coincide in all four acquisitions because every primary assignment was terminally scored.
robustness_notes.scope: The 3B-minus-1B contrasts are prespecified fixed-configuration secondary estimates, not a randomized model-size effect or general scaling law.

robustness_notes.common_window: The two replicates used the same registered 8--407 primary window; common- and registered-full-window results are identical. Versions 408--447 were a frozen guard window and are not an alternative analysis window.
robustness_notes.leave_one_replicate_out: Each workload remains positive and above 0.20 at the point-estimate level when either replicate is omitted; interval-level results are reported per replicate.
robustness_notes.missingness: Sharp lower and upper endpoints coincide in every replicate because all primary assignments were terminally scored.

claim_boundary.not_supported: This outcome-excluded systems qualification does not establish improved terminal training quality, broader model or workload generalization, or an independent causal quality effect.
claim_boundary.supported: M4-Shield is live-actionable in the frozen 64-step qualification: it can change scheduler actions and increase imminent M4 L1 relative to the reward-variance proposer while exactly preserving the two registered reward-variance utilities and satisfying service, liveness, and overhead gates.

metric_discriminant.claim_boundary: Correlations are descriptive. The identification distinction follows from observability: consumed-rollout staleness excludes candidates that never train.
